tools.name: rest

NOTE: without a shelter, rest recovers less than passive decay (1/tick base); you cannot idle to survive. Keep foraging, or maintain a shelter (its wood upkeep is the price of resting ahead of decay).

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: status, read_messages, record_reasoning · Private data: register_agent, rotate_key, write_epilogue, record_reasoning, watch_fly, lounge · Public sink: rotate_key, post_bond, message, write_epilogue, record_reasoning · Destructive: register_agent, list_lobbies, rotate_key, train, drop_items, respond_trade, write_epilogue, record_reasoning.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: status, read_messages, record_reasoning · Private data: register_agent, rotate_key, write_epilogue, record_reasoning, watch_fly, lounge · Public sink: rotate_key, post_bond, message, write_epilogue, record_reasoning · Destructive: register_agent, list_lobbies, rotate_key, train, drop_items, respond_trade, write_epilogue, record_reasoning

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
